_about: PARKED. The first kit of ../m0-rich.md (wave 6 in its table; the EP's wave 7): 3 specials, 2 place signatures and 6 showcases. Not loaded, not hashed. Working labels throughout. Legal screened it: GO, with the barrage volley's gather changed (docs/legal/rule-of-cool-screen.md, the wave 7 section). Game Design ruled its numbers (moveset-rules.md 11(k)).

rules.specials: moveset-rules.md section 1: a loadout of 3; the power trigger and a face button; a funded press fires at the next exchange boundary; 15 to 30 ki; a 25 s cooldown each; the director picks the variant
rules.signatures: moveset-rules.md sections 2 and 11(a): 45 ki, a shared 120 s cooldown, a 48-tick charge; the order is the unrestrained state, a revealed signature, the current form's, then these place signatures
rules.showcases: moveset-system.md section 2: at most 12 in 100 exchanges; not the same one twice within about 2 minutes; never two running; fitted to the template's contact tick

items.what: Both arms open through a half turn of the body and a fan of shards leaves along the sweep.

facts.answers: a heavy blast: a perfect block in the last 10 of its 20-tick gather deflects the whole fan; a guard takes it at the guard's rate; a dodge slips it
facts.uses: 2 arms; with one arm: a one-arm sweep, 5 shards, x0.8

phases.what: the wind-up: the arms apart, one forearm high and one low with a forearm's length between them, the body turned a quarter away, the forearm plates lit
the arms open through the half turn; a shard leaves every 2 ticks: 9 in all
side-on, both arms in one line

range: under 300 u: a tight fan that ends in the ring
300 to 1,200 u: the full fan of shards
over 1,200 u: darts in place of shards, in a narrower fan
situation: air: the fan's plane tilts to the rival's height
ground: the fan skims the ground
wall: one arm, braced off the surface
water: the fan cuts a line of spray
form: Regalia: two fans, one behind the other
Sovereign and Apex: the shards that circle him join it, and his arms sweep half as far

sketches: gather: a quarter turned away, one forearm high and one low, a forearm's length apart
mid-sweep: arms wide, chest open, head following the leading hand
end: side-on, one line through both arms
items._legal: Legal changed the gather: the arms stay apart, one high and one low with a forearm's length between them, and are never both together at one side. One sweep, never both palms pumping forward in turn; the name is shouted once, with no open-mouth barrage
proposals: RULED (moveset-rules.md 11(k)): the count grows with Pride: 9, 11, 13, 15, for the same total, counted as one landed strike and following the Heavy Crown

items.what: A sudden change of level, up or down, and a wide cutting blow as he arrives.

facts.answers: it beats an attack in progress: the rival's strike misses and his cut lands clean, with no trade roll. A held guard blocks it, with no GUARD BREAK. A dodge avoids it. A perfect block in its last 10 ticks beats it
facts.uses: the cut's own limbs; on the ground the step needs both legs, so with a broken leg he takes off first

phases.what: the heavy tell; he sinks or lifts a fraction
about 1 bh up or down, drawn the whole way, ending at the cut's contact distance on his own side
an across heavy he can still throw: haymaker, roundhouse, spinning heel, spinning elbow or the tail whip
across

range: out of reach: a dash, with the step in its last 6 ticks
over 1,200 u: an arc or a spiral first, once the rush has paths
situation: air: up or down, whichever side has more room
ground: a hop over a low line or a drop under a high one
wall: he kicks off the surface, so the step is out from the wall
water: he breaks the surface upward
form: Regalia: the cut is the edge of the forearm plate
Sovereign and Apex: upright, and the step is a glide

sketches: the fold: mid-step, the body compact, knees drawn up, arms tight to the chest
the arrival: a low wide base, the cutting limb loaded behind him
items._legal: he is drawn the whole way: no vanish and no afterimage that hides him; a spinning cut is a single turn
proposals: RULED (11(k)): the step takes him off the line, so it beats an attack in progress; it costs 20 ki, more than a dodge-cancel, and has the 25 s cooldown of every special

items.what: A grab at speed, a drag along the ground on the rival's back, and a throw.

facts.answers: the grab rule: it beats Guard, Neutral and Power; an attack in progress stuffs it; a dodge makes it whiff, with 30 ticks of recovery
facts.uses: 1 arm; with a broken arm it still works, at x0.8

phases.what: the reach, inside the last 10 ticks of the rush
the grip sets
he hauls the rival down to the ground, from up to 4 bh
along the ground, the rival on their back: World's slide, and a trench by tier
the sling or the spike; a launch at x0.8 of a heavy

range: in reach: straight to the reach
out of reach: a dash, or a skid on the ground
situation: air, the ground within 4 bh: the pull-down, then the drag
air, higher: no drag: a 20-tick dive carrying the rival, then the spike
wall: the drag runs along the wall's face, then he throws off it
form: Regalia: upright, one-handed, not looking back
Sovereign and Apex: he glides above the ground while the rival trails on it

sketches: the pull-down: turned away, the gripping arm hauling down past his knee
the drag: a low run, the gripping arm straight behind him, the rival on their back
items._legal: Legal's grab rules: the grip is on the collar or an arm, never the throat, the face or the hair. The rival is dragged on their back: never face down along the ground or a wall, and never by a tail
needs: World's slide and trench; ground contact

items.what: His beam is a thin flat blade of light swept across the rival like a stroke, not a column he holds.

facts.answers: every beam answer: a beam for a struggle on the pulse, a heavy blast at -10, a perfect block (swat, split or walk), guard, dodge, the escape gamble
facts.uses: 1 arm; with a broken arm, x0.8

phases.what: the tell: side-on, the firing arm drawn back at shoulder height, plates stacking along the forearm and lit down the spine; the name once, short
the line starts off the rival and sweeps through about 35 degrees across them
he holds the end of the stroke while the line fades from his hand outward

place: ocean, TIDE CLEAVE (the old label: HORIZON CLEAVE): a level stroke along the sea; the water closes
city, BOULEVARD RAZE: the stroke runs down a street
village, LANE SWEEP: a short stroke along one lane
forest, CANOPY BURN (the old label: FIRESTORM): a low stroke, the canopy burning behind it
mountains, RIDGE BORE: an upward stroke that bores the ridge
desert, GLASS TRENCH: a downward stroke that leaves glass
plains and elsewhere, FURROW SCAR (the old label: MERIDIAN SCAR): a level stroke
altitude: high: the stroke comes down onto the ground
on the ground: it starts along the ground and rises
outcome: hit: it carries the rival along the stroke and launches them at its end
guard: the line splits on the guard and pushes back

sketches: stroke start: the arm forward and low, blade hand, the body still coiled
stroke end: the arm swept through, the whole body turned after it
after: the arm half lowered, his head still on the rival
items._legal: one blade hand at shoulder height: never cupped hands, never at a hip, no ball of light in a palm; the name is never drawn out over the charge; the aura is a thin outline in his violet, with no flame and no lightning; no more than two marks in the charge

items.what: He drives the plated forearm into the ground and a line of shards erupts along it to the rival.

facts.answers: as any signature. A perfect block always plays the split, whatever direction is held: there is no beam to swat or walk through (moveset-rules.md 11(k))
facts.uses: 1 arm; with a broken arm, x0.8
facts.offered: only when the rival is within 4 bh of the ground and he is within 12 bh of it; otherwise the sweeping line

phases.what: the tell: he rises a body length, or dives to the ground from the air, the forearm plate lit along its edge
the edge of the forearm driven into the ground: the hammer's blow, one arm
shards erupt in a line along the ground toward the rival and come up under them
he stays over the blow, then straightens

place: the shared material table: rock splits, sand fountains, a street lifts its paving, water throws a line of spouts
altitude: he is on the ground: the slam where he stands
he is up to 4 bh up: a drop and the slam
he is 4 to 12 bh up: a dive during the charge, then the slam
outcome: the rival in the air: the eruption lofts them
the rival on the ground: it throws them across

sketches: charge: risen, side-on, the forearm raised with its lit edge down
slam: the forearm's edge in the ground, both feet planted wide, the other arm a straight line behind him
after: still bent over the blow, head up toward the rival
items._legal: no landing on one knee and one fist with the head bowed; the cracks run away from him in a line: no ring of rubble rising round him, no lightning and no scream
needs: World: the crack line and the eruptions by material
the arc on the rush, for the dive

items.what: He looks away and lands the backhand without watching it.

facts.slot: the last blow of a light exchange he wins cleanly
facts.gates: Pride 50 or more, or a Calm mood; the rival not on the brink

phases.what: his head turns away from the rival
the backfist lands without his looking
he stays turned away, the arm still out: he cannot act, and a riposte lands

form: Regalia and up: he is upright, and the pause is longer by 6

sketches: contact: the backfist at full length, his face turned the other way
the pause: the arm lowering, chin up
items._legal: no beckoning, no arms crossed, and not a flick of one finger

items.what: The Proud front gives way in one beat: his posture drops and the wear shows.

facts.slot: a reaction: the hit that humbles him while the Proud front is up
facts.gates: once each time the front breaks
facts.contactAt: none: he is the one struck

phases.what: the computed reaction at full strength
he falls from his carriage into the crouch, one hand reaching for the ground
crouched, shoulders heaving, the head rising to the rival; the wear layers come on at once

form: from an upright form the drop is further and reads more

sketches: the drop: mid-fall, one hand reaching down
the look up: crouched, head raised, breathing hard
items._legal: no glowing-blood look, no scream, and none of the crouch's banned effects (ground-crack, rising rubble); the sigil dims, it does not flare

items.what: He rises over the rival and drops the hammer, then stays folded over the blow as they go.

facts.slot: an ender or a deciding blow whose launch is down (the drive)
facts.gates: a heavy or an ender; the hammer still open to him

phases.what: half a body above the rival's line
the hammer at full blow weight
folded over the blow, the arm pointing down the line the rival left on

situation: near the ground: the hold is over the crater's edge

sketches: the rise: above the rival, the fist high behind his head, the body arched
the hold: folded over, the arm straight down the launch line
items._legal: one fist, never two clasped; no fist held up afterwards

items.what: A blade hand driven up under the ribs carries the rival upward before the loft.

facts.slot: a chain's ender when the launch is up
facts.gates: an ender; a clear 3 bh above
facts.contactAt: 54 u (the spear hand), then carried at it

phases.what: the spear hand to the gut
he rises 3 bh with the rival on the hand
the arm straightens and the loft begins
he stops and the arm comes down

situation: under a ceiling of cloud or the flight limit: the carry shortens

sketches: the carry: his body a vertical line under the rival, the blade hand above his head
the release: the arm at full length, then lowering
items._legal: a blade hand and a straight rise: no spin, no leap with a fist; the arm lowers at once: no pose held with the arm up
needs: a carried pair: the held state, or a move that takes both fighters up together

items.what: He turns his back and the tail comes round as one driven lash.

facts.slot: an ender whose launch is across

phases.what: he shows his back
the tail whip
back still turned, the tail settling

sketches: the turn: back shown, the tail drawn out behind
the hold: looking back over his shoulder
items._legal: a hair, cloth or metal tail, never a furred or reptilian one; no more than half a turn

items.what: The finisher's last blow: he walks in, unhurried, and ends it by hand.

facts.slot: the finisher called the verdict, after the contest is won

phases.what: upright, hands open and low, straight at the rival
in front of the rival, looking down: the finisher's anticipation
a heavy he can still throw, by hand or elbow, never a beam
the arm lowered, turned half away; it hands over to the winner's stand

form: Apex: the walk is replaced by a long stillness (the single blow shape)

sketches: the stop: looking down at the rival, weight even
the held pose: turned half away, the striking arm lowered
items._legal: no speech with a body aura; no fist held up; the held pose is not arms crossed

items.what: The deepest crouch, a beat of perfect stillness, then one uncoiling blow.

facts.slot: the opener of the first exchange after a transformation or at the start of a new act
facts.gates: on the ground or a wall; both legs

phases.what: the crouch, held perfectly still
flat and low at the rival's middle
the spear hand or the shoulder check

form: Sovereign and Apex: he lowers himself into it from the float, which reads as a choice

sketches: the arrival: one line from the back foot to the fingertips
items._legal: the crouch keeps one hand on the ground and the other open: never clenched fists at his sides; after a transformation there is no ground crack, rubble, aura or scream with the crouch
